hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-medium tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100

rules: No generic sans fonts for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk.
Never center-align paragraphs; maintain left alignment for readability.
Use tinted greys instead of pure #000000 or #808080.
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast standards.
Hover states must be explicitly defined and have higher contrast.
Reserve red strictly for critical risks/needs attention to prevent alert fatigue.

surfaces: Flat solid backgrounds with subtle 1px border (`border-border`) and no shadow by default for Dashboard Cards.
Hover on interactive cards: Slight lift (`-translate-y-1`) and subtle shadow (`shadow-lg`).
Use Crystal Glass for sticky headers (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70` with `border-b border-white/20`).
components: Shadcn UI strictly for interactive logic (Tabs, Dropdowns, Dialogs, Select).
For KPI Cards, use `rounded-xl`, tight padding, and clear hierarchical typography.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlapping elements like Dropdowns.

grids.kpi_row: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
rules: Grid children must be direct children.
Ensure `h-full` is used so side-by-side cards match heights.

layouts.header: Sticky header with Title, Breadcrumbs, and active User Role indicator.
layouts.kpi_section: 4-column grid displaying Suppliers Assessed, Avg ESG Score, Top Performer, Needs Attention.
layouts.tabs_section: Shadcn Tabs: Overview, ESG Analysis, Emissions, Detailed Rankings. Active: Overview.
layouts.summary_bar: Flex row showing summary counts: Excellent (0), Good (0), Needs attention (1).
layouts.body_section: 12-column grid. Left (col-span-4): Overall Score Distribution. Right (col-span-8): Assessment Module Coverage.
layouts.tables_section: Grid of 2 (col-span-6 each) for 'Top Performing Suppliers' and 'Attention Required' with 'View all' action links.

rules: Staggered entrance animations for KPI cards and list items.
Hover effects on table rows (subtle background change).
Click/Press states on all buttons and tabs.
Focus states must have high contrast rings.
Ensure sufficient color contrast for the Overall Score Distribution categories (Excellent, Good, Needs Improvement, Critical).

icons.usage: Use icons for KPI cards (e.g., Users, TrendingUp, Award, AlertTriangle) and list item avatars.

instructions_to_main_agent: Phase 1: Create the SupplierAssessmentRankingOverview component based on the extracted PDF layout.
Phase 2: Implement the KPI Row containing: Assessed, Avg ESG Score, Top Performer, Needs Attention.
Phase 3: Implement Shadcn Tabs for navigating the Assessment views.
Phase 4: Implement 'Overall Score Distribution' widget using clean Progress Bars or a Recharts Donut.
Phase 5: Implement 'Assessment Module Coverage' widget showing ESG, GHG, Documents, and Training percentages.
Phase 6: Implement dual tables for 'Top Performing Suppliers' and 'Attention Required'.
Phase 7 (RBAC Integration): Implement conditional rendering based on the new Role-Based Access Control logic.
RBAC Rule 1: 'Admins & Users' module replaces previous configs. Super Admins can manage both.
RBAC Rule 2: Normal Users with 'write-only' access should see a restricted view or a 'Data Submitted' screen instead of the full ranking overview.
RBAC Rule 3: 'Plant Head' role should only see aggregated data for their assigned plants.
Always apply 'data-testid' to critical DOM elements.
Create `.js` or `.jsx` files inside `/app/frontend/src/pages/` or `/app/frontend/src/modules/supplier-assessment/` as appropriate.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than usual).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
